parameters.query:
INSERT INTO articles (url, title, source, content, published_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
ON CONFLICT (url) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, title, source, content;

WITH journal AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (event, details)
  SELECT 'summary_review', jsonb_build_object('rejets', $3::jsonb, 'ia_disponible', $4::boolean)
  WHERE jsonb_array_length($3::jsonb) > 0 OR NOT $4::boolean
)
UPDATE articles a
SET tags = COALESCE(
      NULLIF(ARRAY(
        SELECT t FROM json_array_elements_text(x.tags) AS t
        WHERE t = ANY (ARRAY['politique','international','économie','société','sport','culture',
                             'technologie','science','espace','santé','environnement',
                             'jeux-vidéo','faits-divers','autre'])
      ), '{}'),
      ARRAY['autre']),
    summary = left(x.summary, 500)
FROM json_to_recordset($1::json) AS x(id bigint, tags json, summary text)
WHERE a.id = x.id
  AND a.id IN (SELECT json_array_elements_text($2::json)::bigint)
RETURNING a.id, a.tags;
